name: What types of materials are used for deck repair?

mainEntity.name: What types of materials are used for deck repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The materials used for deck repair depend on the existing deck's construction and the extent of the damage. Common materials include pressure-treated lumber for structural components, cedar or redwood for decking boards, and composite materials for low-maintenance options. We also use various fasteners, connectors, and weather-resistant coatings to ensure durability and longevity. We prioritize matching materials to your existing deck where possible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common materials include pressure-treated lumber, cedar, redwood, or composite for boards, plus fasteners and weather-resistant coatings.
